# Tailwind CSS Gradient Border Plugin

> A simple Tailwind CSS plugin for beautiful gradient borders using mask-composite. Mirrors Tailwind's gradient utilities with `from`/`via`/`to` color stops, four configurable widths, an animated rotating variant, and full support for arbitrary color values, alpha modifiers, and conic/radial overrides.

This project ships as a CSS plugin you import alongside TailwindCSS. Apply the `gradient-border` class to any element to enable a gradient stroke that follows its `border-radius`. Combine with direction utilities like `gradient-border-to-r`, color stops like `gradient-border-from-blue-500`, and width variants like `gradient-border-2`. For full control, override `--gradient-border` with any CSS background image (conic, radial, multi-stop, etc.).
